findings.title: Broad primitive role: roles/owner
findings.description: A principal has a broad primitive role that exceeds typical least-privilege requirements.
findings.remediation: Replace primitive roles with predefined or custom roles containing only required permissions.

findings.title: Public or globally authenticated access
findings.description: The IAM binding grants access to a public principal.
findings.remediation: Remove the public member and grant the minimum role to explicitly identified principals.

findings.title: IAM policy modification
findings.description: A principal can change project IAM bindings and grant additional access.
findings.remediation: Restrict this permission to a controlled deployment identity and require short-lived credentials and approval controls.

findings.title: Service-account impersonation reaches a privileged role
findings.description: The principal can obtain short-lived credentials for a service account with broad access.
findings.remediation: Remove unnecessary Token Creator bindings and grant impersonation only on narrowly scoped service accounts.

findings.title: IAM policy modification can escalate to project Owner
findings.description: The principal can modify the project IAM policy and grant itself or another controlled identity the Owner role.
findings.remediation: Restrict project IAM policy modification to a controlled administrative identity. Require approval, audit IAM changes, and prevent direct Owner grants.

findings.title: Key creation reaches a privileged service account
findings.description: The principal can create a long-lived key for a service account that has a broad primitive role.
evidence: user:contractor@example.test has roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin on projects/payments-prod/serviceAccounts/deployment@payments-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com inherited from projects/payments-prod
findings.remediation: Remove unnecessary service-account key creation access. Use short-lived credentials, workload identity federation, and organization policies that disable service-account key creation.

findings.title: Broad primitive role: roles/editor
findings.description: A principal has a broad primitive role that exceeds typical least-privilege requirements.
findings.remediation: Replace primitive roles with predefined or custom roles containing only required permissions.

findings.title: Service-account key creation
findings.description: A principal can create long-lived credentials for a service account.
findings.remediation: Restrict this permission to a controlled deployment identity and require short-lived credentials and approval controls.
